title: Enter the workspace
steps: Open the sign-in address supplied by your administrator.
Enter your email and password, then choose Sign in. The Sign in as selector appears only in demo mode.
Live accounts receive their access from saved roles; use your own account details.
result: A successful sign-in opens your first permitted page.

title: Recognize your workspace
steps: Confirm the barangay and fiscal year shown in the workspace.
Use the left sidebar to open your task. The selected page is highlighted.
Read the summary cards and recent transactions before starting work.
result: Your sidebar reflects your saved page access. These screenshots use a Super admin demo account.

title: Review the system branding
steps: As Super admin, open White label in the sidebar.
Edit the system name, organization, logo mark or logo image, and accent color.
Check the preview before saving. This image shows the demo system branding editor.
result: Live mode also provides Onboard barangay and a branding scope selector; follow the setup chapter for those live-only controls.

title: Find a person or add an account
steps: Open Staff & access and confirm the barangay.
Search the directory to check whether the person already exists.
Choose Add account (Super admin) or Add staff (Administrator).
result: The directory shows each person’s role, status and page access.

title: Set the person’s role and pages
steps: Enter the person’s name and email; select their role.
Review Page access. Check a page to include it or uncheck it to remove it.
Scroll to Add to [barangay], review the confirmation, then save when the details are correct.
result: The demo form omits the live initial-password field. Page choices change viewing access; they do not grant financial posting authority.

title: Review the page list and save access
steps: Scroll down within the account form to see all page checkboxes.
Keep the intended pages selected. Use role defaults restores the role’s standard selection.
Choose Add to Barangay San Isidro, review the confirmation and choose Add account.
result: The role and page selection will be saved for this person in this barangay.

title: Verify the new staff account
steps: Find Training Encoder in the staff directory.
Check the Encoder role and active status.
Use Customize pages to review or change viewing access, or Deactivate if this access must end.
result: Demo accounts are practice entries in this browser. Live mode creates or links a sign-in account.

title: Change an existing person’s pages
steps: In the person’s row, choose Customize pages.
Adjust the checkboxes, or choose Use role defaults to restore their role’s pages.
Choose Save page access to apply the selection. Settings remains available.
result: Custom choices replace that account’s role defaults for the selected barangay.

title: Read the budget before entering an expense
steps: Open Budget and check the fiscal year.
Read Total appropriation, Obligated and Available to commit.
Find the intended budget line, then choose Add budget line if a new line is needed.
result: Available to commit is the amount still available after submitted vouchers.

title: Enter and save a budget line
steps: Enter a unique Code and a clear Budget line name.
Choose the Category and enter the appropriation in pesos. Example: 50000 means ₱50,000.00.
Choose Save budget line and confirm the line appears in Budget lines.
result: This example adds MOOE-004 / Community programs with ₱50,000.00.

title: Review the confirmation before saving
steps: Read the confirmation message before a record is saved or changed.
Check the code, name and amount. Choose Cancel to go back and correct a mistake.
Choose Add budget line to confirm. Similar confirmations appear for financial actions throughout the system.
result: The action is applied only after you confirm the details.

title: Check the saved budget line
steps: Find MOOE-004 in Budget lines.
Verify the name, category and appropriation match your entry.
For a new unused line, its available amount should equal its appropriation.
result: The saved line is ready to select when creating an expense case.

title: Start a purchase request
steps: Open Procurement.
Use the document path to see PR → RFQ → PO → AIR → Ready for DV.
Choose New procurement to enter the purchase request.
result: Existing records show their current step and the next available action.

title: Fill in the purchase request
steps: Enter the supplier or payee, amount and purpose.
Select the correct Budget line and check Available beneath it.
Choose Create case. This example requests ₱1,500.00 for training office supplies.
result: The request is saved at PR and appears in the procurement register.

title: Complete the PR stage
steps: Find Training office supplies in the register.
Check its payee, amount and PR status.
Choose Complete PR after the corresponding work is complete.
result: The next status is RFQ. Demo buttons illustrate the sequence; retain the required evidence in live operations.

title: Continue through quotations and purchase order
steps: The request now shows RFQ.
Complete the quotation work, then choose Complete RFQ on the same row.
At PO, complete the purchase order and choose Complete PO.
result: Each completed stage advances this same expense case; do not create a duplicate request.

title: Inspect before preparing the voucher
steps: Confirm the case has reached AIR.
Complete the acceptance and inspection work.
Choose Complete AIR on the same request.
result: The case becomes Ready for DV and its action changes to Create DV.

title: Create the linked disbursement voucher
steps: Confirm the case is Ready for DV.
Choose Create DV once for this case.
Open Disbursements and locate the new draft by payee and purpose.
result: The source case and draft voucher remain linked.

title: Enter a payroll expense
steps: Open this expense route from the Spending sidebar and choose New.
Enter the payee, amount and purpose; select the matching budget line.
Choose Create case, then Create DV on the Ready for DV record. Continue in Disbursements.
result: These routes use the same linked voucher review and payment steps as procurement.

title: Enter a recurring fee expense
steps: Open this expense route from the Spending sidebar and choose New.
Enter the payee, amount and purpose; select the matching budget line.
Choose Create case, then Create DV on the Ready for DV record. Continue in Disbursements.
result: These routes use the same linked voucher review and payment steps as procurement.

title: Enter a travel expense
steps: Open this expense route from the Spending sidebar and choose New.
Enter the payee, amount and purpose; select the matching budget line.
Choose Create case, then Create DV on the Ready for DV record. Continue in Disbursements.
result: If the paid travel voucher represents a cash advance, continue to Cash advances after payment.

title: Enter a SK transfer expense
steps: Open this expense route from the Spending sidebar and choose New.
Enter the payee, amount and purpose; select the matching budget line.
Choose Create case, then Create DV on the Ready for DV record. Continue in Disbursements.
result: These routes use the same linked voucher review and payment steps as procurement.

title: Find the draft voucher
steps: Open Disbursements.
Search by payee, purpose or voucher number, and use the status filter if needed.
Select the Training Supply Co. voucher row to open the linked voucher panel.
result: Draft, submitted, approved and paid vouchers appear in the same register.

title: Check the draft and submit it
steps: Review the payee, amount, purpose, source document and budget line in the voucher panel.
Confirm the source case is the intended purchase request.
Choose Submit for review.
result: The voucher changes from draft to submitted and commits budget availability.

title: Review and approve the submitted voucher
steps: Check the submitted voucher and its supporting records.
Choose Approve when correct, or Reject when a correction is needed.
In live mode, an assigned Approver in this barangay or a Super admin can approve/reject. Ordinary self-approval is blocked.
result: Approval records the obligation and makes the voucher ready for payment.

title: Approver: confirm the approval decision
steps: Read the voucher number, payee and amount in the approval confirmation.
Choose Cancel to return to the submitted voucher if anything is wrong.
Choose Approve voucher to save the decision, then check the approved status.
result: An assigned Approver can do this in their barangay; ordinary self-approval is blocked. The pictured account is a Super admin demo.

title: Record the payment reference
steps: After payment is issued, enter the actual check or transfer reference.
Check the voucher number and amount again.
As the assigned Treasurer or Super admin, choose Record payment and review its confirmation.
result: This training example uses TRAINING-CHK-0001. Use the real payment reference in live work.

title: Treasurer: confirm the recorded payment
steps: Read the voucher number, full payment amount and payment reference.
Choose Cancel if the payment or reference needs checking.
Choose Record payment to confirm, then check paid status and the saved reference.
result: An assigned Treasurer can record the payment in their barangay. Recording this entry does not initiate a bank transfer or issue a check.

title: Confirm that the voucher is paid
steps: Check the paid status at the top of the voucher panel.
Verify the payment reference and recorded payment date.
Use Print / Save PDF if you need a system record copy.
result: The paid voucher remains linked to its expense case and appears in reporting.

title: Open an advance from a paid travel voucher
steps: Open Cash advances after the travel voucher is paid.
Find the eligible voucher and accountable person.
Choose Open advance only if this payment was cash given to that person.
result: Opening tracking does not create a second payment. The example advance is ₱8,900.00.

title: Record an accepted liquidation expense
steps: Choose View on the advance to open Liquidation.
Keep Entry type as Accepted expense; enter the evidence reference and amount.
Choose Record entry. This example accepts ₱8,000.00 against ₱8,900.00.
result: The remaining outstanding amount will be ₱900.00. Record accepted amounts only.

title: Return the unused balance
steps: Choose Cash refund as Entry type.
Enter the return acknowledgment and the unused amount, here ₱900.00.
Choose Record entry and confirm the advance becomes fully settled.
result: Accepted expenses plus refunds must equal the advance before its balance reaches zero.

title: Verify the settled advance
steps: Check the accepted expense and refund entries in Liquidation.
Confirm the fully settled message.
Keep the evidence references with the case; use PDF for a system record copy.
result: ₱8,000.00 accepted + ₱900.00 refunded = ₱8,900.00 settled.

title: Start a collection receipt
steps: Open Collections and review the summary amounts.
Check the receipt register for an existing entry.
Choose Record collection to record a new receipt.
result: Awaiting matching is the collection balance still to allocate to a deposit or remittance.

title: Enter and save the receipt
steps: Enter the payer and choose the collection category.
Enter the amount in pesos and describe the particulars.
Choose Issue receipt. The example records ₱1,000.00 for Training Payer.
result: The application assigns the receipt number; the new receipt starts with an unmatched balance.

title: Check the new receipt
steps: Find Training Payer in the receipt register.
Verify the receipt number, amount, category and particulars.
Continue to Deposits & remittances when the real treasury movement is ready.
result: Saving a receipt does not automatically match it to a bank deposit.

title: Allocate receipts to a bank deposit
steps: Choose New matching batch and keep Bank deposit selected.
Enter the bank and the real reference or acknowledgment.
Select the receipt checkbox; adjust the allocation in pesos for a partial match.
result: This image allocates the complete ₱1,000.00 training receipt. Batch total equals the selected allocations.

title: Check the confirmed matching batch
steps: Find TRAINING-DEP-0001 in the matching register.
Verify its type, bank, total and allocated receipt.
Check that the receipt’s unmatched balance has decreased by the allocation.
result: A confirmed bank deposit moves the selected amount from cash to bank.

title: Record a treasury remittance
steps: Choose Treasury remittance under Transaction type.
Enter the receiving treasury and acknowledgment reference.
Select the receipts and allocations, review Batch total, then confirm when correct.
result: A remittance reduces cash and increases remitted collections. Use a bank deposit for movements into the bank.

title: Choose and check a report
steps: Open Reports and choose a report from Available reports.
Check the fiscal year, displayed columns and totals against the underlying registers.
Choose CSV for data or Print / Save PDF for the selected report. Print / Save all reports combines the available previews.
result: The report shown is a working preview drawn from the demo records.

title: Save a report as PDF
steps: The Print / Save PDF action prepares a barangay-branded system record copy like this.
In the browser print dialog, choose Save as PDF as the destination.
Review the pages, then choose Save and select the file location.
result: This image shows the printable document; the browser’s print dialog varies by device. System copies do not replace prescribed official forms.

title: Trace the actions in the audit trail
steps: Open Audit trail. Search by name, email or record, then narrow the log with Action, Account and Manila date filters.
Events are grouped by date. Expand Event details to inspect the account ID, event ID and full recorded details.
Use Next / Previous and Rows per page to browse. Export filtered log includes all matching loaded events across pages.
result: Super admin actions identify the Super admin account; actions are not attributed to the staff member whose access is being changed.

title: Find account settings and demo reset
steps: Open Settings from the sidebar.
In live mode, use the account section to change your password when needed.
Restore demo data resets this browser’s training records; use it only when you intend to restart practice.
result: Settings remains available even when an account has no selected financial pages.
